cards.example_en: I have a mild headache, so I'll rest briefly.
cards.example_zh: 我有点头痛，所以要稍微休息一下。
cards.explain_zh: mild 可形容症状、天气和味道，不等于“无害”。

cards.example_en: I have a mild headache, so I'll rest briefly.
cards.example_zh: 我有点头痛，所以要稍微休息一下。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We shared a room with other travellers at the hostel.
cards.example_zh: 我们在旅舍和其他旅行者合住一个房间。
cards.explain_zh: hostel常有多人间，hotel通常提供独立客房。

cards.example_en: My sister-in-law brought homemade soup when I was ill.
cards.example_zh: 我生病时，嫂子送来了她自己做的汤。
cards.explain_zh: 指姻亲姐妹，不是继姐妹；复数sisters-in-law。

cards.example_en: The mountain view from our tent was absolutely awesome.
cards.example_zh: 从我们的帐篷望出去，山景简直棒极了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“超棒”时较口语；正式写作宜选更具体的词。

cards.example_en: The awesome power of volcanic eruptions highlights the importance of effective monitoring systems in nearby communities.
cards.example_zh: 火山喷发令人敬畏的威力凸显了周边社区建立有效监测系统的重要性。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
cards.example_zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚会上的每个人都笑了。
cards.explain_zh: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

cards.example_en: My hands were freezing after waiting outside for the bus.
cards.example_zh: 在外面等公交车后，我的双手冰冷。
cards.explain_zh: I'm freezing表示我冷极了，不一定真的结冰。

cards.example_en: Freezing temperatures can damage water pipes and disrupt essential services, particularly in areas with ageing infrastructure.
cards.example_zh: 冰冻天气可能损坏水管并扰乱基本服务，尤其是在基础设施老化的地区。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Swimming every morning has really improved my fitness.
cards.example_zh: 每天早晨游泳确实提高了我的体能。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；fitness for表示对某事的适合程度。

cards.example_en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
cards.example_zh: 喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。
cards.explain_zh: statue是雕像；status是地位，注意拼写区别。

cards.example_en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
cards.example_zh: 喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She sliced the cabbage thinly and added it to soup.
cards.example_zh: 她把卷心菜切成细丝，放进汤里。
cards.explain_zh: 整颗可数：a cabbage；作为食材通常不可数。

cards.example_en: We found an inexpensive café near the train station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。
cards.explain_zh: 比cheap更中性，通常不暗示质量差。

cards.example_en: Cycling offers an inexpensive alternative to driving and can help reduce traffic congestion in growing cities.
cards.example_zh: 骑自行车是驾车之外一种经济实惠的选择，也有助于缓解发展中城市的交通拥堵。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The cat curled up on the rug beside the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 猫蜷卧在沙发旁的小地毯上。
cards.explain_zh: rug通常只覆盖部分地面；carpet可铺满整个房间。

cards.example_en: Our workplace has a quiet room for lunch breaks.
cards.example_zh: 我们的工作场所有一间安静的房间，供午休使用。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指办公室、工厂等工作场所，不等于单指办公室。

cards.example_en: Our intelligent puppy quickly learned how to open doors.
cards.example_zh: 我们那只聪明的小狗很快就学会了开门。
cards.explain_zh: intelligent指聪明的；intelligible指可理解的。

cards.example_en: Our guide explained why it stays warm near the equator.
cards.example_zh: 导游解释了为什么赤道附近一直很暖和。
cards.explain_zh: 赤道前通常加the；形容词是equatorial。

cards.example_en: Our guide explained why it stays warm near the equator.
cards.example_zh: 导游解释了为什么赤道附近一直很暖和。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I packed suncream and a hat for our afternoon walk.
cards.example_zh: 我为下午的散步带好了防晒霜和帽子。
cards.explain_zh: 主要用于英式英语，也常写作sun cream。

cards.example_en: I put the signed form in a blue envelope.
cards.example_zh: 我把签好字的表格放进了一个蓝色信封。
cards.explain_zh: signed可作形容词；“由某人签署”用signed by。

cards.example_en: A signed agreement helps protect both tenants and landlords by clearly defining their rights and responsibilities.
cards.example_zh: 签署的协议通过明确租客和房东的权利与责任，有助于保护双方。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My waterproof jacket kept me dry during the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨中，我的防水夹克让我没有淋湿。
cards.explain_zh: water-resistant仅指有一定抗水能力，防水程度较弱。

cards.example_en: The pool has a lift for disabled swimmers.
cards.example_zh: 游泳池设有供残障游泳者使用的升降设备。
cards.explain_zh: 可说disabled people或people with disabilities，尊重本人偏好。

cards.example_en: My sister starts her first full-time job next week.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐下周开始做她的第一份全职工作。
cards.explain_zh: 修饰名词时保留连字符，如a full-time job。

cards.example_en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to return to full-time employment without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
cards.example_zh: 负担得起的托育服务使更多家长能够重返全职工作，同时不会给家庭经济带来过大压力。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
cards.example_zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。
cards.explain_zh: recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。

cards.example_en: We usually roast potatoes with garlic and fresh herbs.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常用大蒜和新鲜香草烤土豆。
cards.explain_zh: roast多用于肉和蔬菜；烤面包、蛋糕通常用bake。

cards.example_en: Please chop the carrots while I heat the soup.
cards.example_zh: 我来热汤，请你把胡萝卜切碎。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式chopped，进行式chopping，均双写p。

cards.example_en: When communities chop down trees for fuel, they may unintentionally damage habitats and increase soil erosion.
cards.example_zh: 当社区居民砍树用作燃料时，他们可能无意中破坏栖息地，加剧水土流失。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Olive cultivation supports rural livelihoods in dry regions, although prolonged drought can significantly reduce harvests.
cards.example_zh: 橄榄种植支撑着干旱地区农村居民的生计，但长期干旱会使收成大幅下降。
cards.explain_zh: olive可指果实、树或颜色；olive oil通常不可数。

cards.example_en: She felt a deep sadness when her friend moved away.
cards.example_zh: 朋友搬走时，她感到深深的难过。
cards.explain_zh: 通常作不可数名词；a sense of sadness指一种悲伤感。

cards.example_en: She felt a deep sadness when her friend moved away.
cards.example_zh: 朋友搬走时，她感到深深的难过。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We shared a cab home after the concert.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会结束后，我们合乘一辆出租车回家。
cards.explain_zh: 表示出租车时与taxi同义；也可指卡车等的驾驶室。

cards.example_en: The garden looks gorgeous in the early morning sunshine.
cards.example_zh: 花园在清晨的阳光下显得格外美丽。
cards.explain_zh: 语气比beautiful强，多用于口语中的赞美。

cards.example_en: Although coastal destinations offer gorgeous scenery, uncontrolled tourism can damage the natural environments that attract visitors.
cards.example_zh: 虽然海滨旅游地景色迷人，但不加控制的旅游活动会破坏吸引游客的自然环境。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We spotted an orange starfish in a shallow rock pool.
cards.example_zh: 我们在一个浅浅的岩石潮池里发现了一只橙色海星。
cards.explain_zh: 单复数通常同形；海星是无脊椎动物，不是鱼类。

cards.example_en: Changes in ocean temperature can affect starfish populations and disrupt the balance of coastal ecosystems.
cards.example_zh: 海水温度变化会影响海星种群，并扰乱沿海生态系统的平衡。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She climbed the ladder to pick apples from the tree.
cards.example_zh: 她爬上梯子，摘树上的苹果。
cards.explain_zh: ladder是可移动的梯子；stairs指建筑内楼梯。

cards.example_en: Access to professional training can help young employees move up the career ladder more quickly.
cards.example_zh: 获得专业培训的机会可以帮助年轻员工更快地晋升。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The electrician fixed the broken light in our kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 电工修好了我们厨房里坏掉的灯。
cards.explain_zh: electrician指电工；电气工程师是electrical engineer。

cards.example_en: She polished her shoes until they looked shiny.
cards.example_zh: 她把鞋擦得亮亮的。
cards.explain_zh: 指表面反光，不等于物体本身发光。

cards.example_en: It was foolish to leave my umbrella at home.
cards.example_zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。
cards.explain_zh: 常用It is foolish to do表示做某事不明智。

cards.example_en: She put her jacket on a wooden hanger.
cards.example_zh: 她把夹克挂在一个木衣架上。
cards.explain_zh: hanger是衣架；hangar是飞机库，注意拼写。

cards.example_en: She put her jacket on a wooden hanger.
cards.example_zh: 她把夹克挂在一个木衣架上。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A blue jewel sparkled on her silver necklace.
cards.example_zh: 她银项链上的一颗蓝色宝石闪闪发光。
cards.explain_zh: jewel可数；jewellery指珠宝总称，不可数。

cards.example_en: The friendly monster in the cartoon has purple feet.
cards.example_zh: 动画片里那只友善的怪物长着紫色的脚。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词用法较口语化，置于名词前表示巨大。

cards.example_en: She became fluent in Spanish after living abroad.
cards.example_zh: 在国外生活后，她能流利地说西班牙语了。
cards.explain_zh: 说某种语言流利用be fluent in；流利不等于零错误。
